sections.heading: Combat Indicator (CI) on Meridian Rift
sections.text: Synthetic glossary: CI is the Combat Indicator, a Meridian Rift rule (Antagonist Policy CI-01). "Combat intent" means the same thing.

sections.heading: CI on Wolfgate
sections.text: Synthetic glossary: Wolfgate does not use CI. Escalation follows Conflict Rule 1: declare it in local, shortband or broadband chat.
